services.name: Minke Whales
services.desc: Located off the coast of Massachusetts in the North Atlantic Ocean, Cape Cod Bay has a tremendous whale population with a range of species, giving you the opportunity to see whales you may have only read about. At Captain John Boats, we take groups out on whale-watching excursions from Plymouth and Provincetown, getting you up close with humpback, finback, and minke whales and more. Cape Cod’s whale watching history dates back more than 40 years, with a long period prior to that of whaling. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Join us for a sunset cruise around Plymouth Harbor and sit back and enjoy the fireworks! Galley available on board. Boarding begins at 7:00 pm, boat departs promptly at 7:30 pm and returns at the conclusion of the fireworks. Cruise around Plymouth Harbor and watch the fireworks. Perfect for families, as we’ll have music, glow sticks, tattoos and popcorn. No alcohol available on board. Captain John Boats is conveniently located in Plymouth, Massachusetts along the coast of New England. We are located 45 minutes south of Boston and 45 minutes north of New Bedford.
